lines.english: Yesterday I queued at the bookshop for four hours before I got that actor's autograph.

lines.simplified: 四个小时？你脑子里在想什么啊？那些时间能做多少事！

lines.english: Four hours? What were you thinking? Think how much you could have done in that time!

lines.speaker: F

lines.english: Don't say that. You're not a fan, so of course you don't get it. Hearing him tell me to keep going made me so happy!

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我有一個朋友以前是律師，去年不做了，跑到山上開了一家小咖啡店。
lines.simplified: 我有一个朋友以前是律师，去年不做了，跑到山上开了一家小咖啡店。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí ge péngyǒu yǐqián shì lǜshī, qùnián bú zuò le, pǎo dào shān shàng kāi le yì jiā xiǎo kāfēi diàn.
lines.english: A friend of mine used to be a lawyer. Last year he quit and went off to open a little café in the mountains.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不當律師了？那多可惜啊！他念了那麼多年的法律。
lines.simplified: 不当律师了？那多可惜啊！他念了那么多年的法律。
lines.pinyin: Bù dāng lǜshī le? Nà duó kěxí a! Tā niàn le nàme duō nián de fǎlǜ.
lines.english: He gave up law? What a pity! He studied law for so many years.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他可不這麼想。他說以前天天加班，現在每天看著山煮咖啡，多麼輕鬆啊！
lines.simplified: 他可不这么想。他说以前天天加班，现在每天看着山煮咖啡，多么轻松啊！
lines.pinyin: Tā kě bú zhème xiǎng. Tā shuō yǐqián tiāntiān jiābān, xiànzài měi tiān kàn zhe shān zhǔ kāfēi, duóme qīngsōng a!
lines.english: He doesn't see it that way at all. He says he used to work overtime every day, and now he makes coffee looking at the mountains. How relaxing!

prompt.simplified: 那位朋友觉得现在的生活怎么样？

choices.english: He wants to go back to being a lawyer.

questions.why: The friend says 多麼輕鬆啊 about his new life, and 可不這麼想 rejects the woman's 多可惜啊. Wasted years of law is her view, overtime was his old life, and he does not want law back.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這張畫是我女兒畫的。她說這是她夢到的地方，天上有魚，海裡有鳥。
lines.simplified: 这张画是我女儿画的。她说这是她梦到的地方，天上有鱼，海里有鸟。
lines.pinyin: Zhè zhāng huà shì wǒ nǚ'ér huà de. Tā shuō zhè shì tā mèngdào de dìfāng, tiān shàng yǒu yú, hǎi lǐ yǒu niǎo.
lines.english: My daughter drew this picture. She says it is a place she dreamed of: fish in the sky, birds in the sea.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 她才六歲就畫得出這樣的畫，多有想像力啊！以後可以讓她去學設計。
lines.simplified: 她才六岁就画得出这样的画，多有想像力啊！以后可以让她去学设计。
lines.pinyin: Tā cái liù suì jiù huà de chū zhèyàng de huà, duō yǒu xiǎngxiànglì a! Yǐhòu kěyǐ ràng tā qù xué shèjì.
lines.english: She is only six and she can draw a picture like this. What an imagination! Later you could let her study design.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我也這麼想，可是她說長大要當醫生。
lines.simplified: 我也这么想，可是她说长大要当医生。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě zhème xiǎng, kěshì tā shuō zhǎngdà yào dāng yīshēng.
lines.english: I think so too, but she says she wants to be a doctor when she grows up.

choices.english: The fish and birds do not look right.

choices.english: The place in it is too strange.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 孩子畫得出來很不簡單
choices.simplified: 孩子画得出来很不简单
choices.pinyin: Háizi huà de chūlái hěn bù jiǎndān.
choices.english: It is impressive that a child could draw it.

questions.why: 她才六歲就畫得出這樣的畫，多有想像力啊: she admires a six-year-old for drawing it. The place is one the girl dreamed, not a real one; she never criticises the fish or birds; fish in the sky is what she calls imagination, not something strange.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說你在那部新戲裡只演一個服務生，只有兩句話要說？
lines.simplified: 听说你在那部新戏里只演一个服务生，只有两句话要说？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ zài nà bù xīn xì lǐ zhǐ yǎn yí ge fúwùshēng, zhǐyǒu liǎng jù huà yào shuō?
lines.english: I hear you only play a waiter in that new play, with just two lines to say?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對啊。導演說我長得不錯，可是實力還不夠，得先從小角色開始。
lines.simplified: 对啊。导演说我长得不错，可是实力还不够，得先从小角色开始。
lines.pinyin: Duì a. Dǎoyǎn shuō wǒ zhǎng de búcuò, kěshì shílì hái bú gòu, děi xiān cóng xiǎo jiǎosè kāishǐ.
lines.english: That's right. The director says I'm good-looking but I'm not good enough yet, so I have to start with small roles.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你不覺得可惜嗎？
lines.simplified: 你不觉得可惜吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bù juéde kěxí ma?
lines.english: Don't you think it's a pity?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不會。就算只有兩句話，我也要讓觀眾記住這個服務生。
lines.simplified: 不会。就算只有两句话，我也要让观众记住这个服务生。
lines.pinyin: Bú huì. Jiùsuàn zhǐyǒu liǎng jù huà, wǒ yě yào ràng guānzhòng jìzhù zhège fúwùshēng.
lines.english: No. Even with only two lines, I want the audience to remember this waiter.

choices.english: He is already good enough.

questions.why: 就算只有兩句話，我也要讓觀眾記住: the small part does not change his plan to do it well. Calling it a pity is the woman's idea, he never asks for another role, and the director said his 實力 is 還不夠.

lines.speaker: F

lines.simplified: 你最近每天都留在公司录音，录到半夜才回家，不累吗？

lines.english: Lately you stay at the office recording every day and only get home at midnight. Aren't you tired?

lines.speaker: M

lines.simplified: 累啊。可是这个节目下星期一就要开始了。
lines.pinyin: Lèi a. Kěshì zhège jiémù xià xīngqíyī jiù yào kāishǐ le.
lines.english: Of course. But this programme starts next Monday.

lines.simplified: 那也不用每天录到这么晚吧？
lines.pinyin: Nà yě bú yòng měi tiān lù dào zhème wǎn ba?
lines.english: Still, you don't need to record this late every day, do you?

lines.english: Even if I can only rest four hours a day, I have to finish recording before Sunday.

lines.pinyin: Zhège biǎoyǎn kèchéng yí ge yuè yào yí wàn kuài, nǐ fù de qǐ ma?
lines.english: This acting course costs ten thousand dollars a month. Can you afford it?

lines.simplified: 晚上十点那个说故事的节目，下个月就不做了，你知道吗？

lines.english: Really? I started listening in high school and it's been fifteen years. You could say I'm one of its longtime listeners.

lines.traditional: 聽說做這個節目的老先生以前是律師，要退休了，想多留點時間給家人。這麼好的節目越來越少了。

choices.english: It is about his own childhood.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn huā de shíjiān tài cháng le.
choices.english: The director took too long.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bǐ dǎoyǎn yǐqián pāi de dōu hǎo.
choices.english: It is better than the director's earlier films.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 裡面的衣服不像以前的
choices.simplified: 里面的衣服不像以前的
choices.pinyin: Lǐmiàn de yīfú bú xiàng yǐqián de.
choices.english: The clothes in it do not look like the old ones.

questions.why: 可說是他拍得最好的電影: of all the director's films, this is the best. The film is about Taipei in the eighties, not the man's own story; he praises the three years rather than complaining; the clothes are just like the ones he remembers.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳奶奶七十歲了，還在學電腦啊？
lines.simplified: 你奶奶七十岁了，还在学电脑啊？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ nǎinai qīshí suì le, hái zài xué diànnǎo a?
lines.english: Your grandmother is seventy and still learning computers?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對啊，她不斷地學新東西，現在還會在網路上看戲，一看就是好幾個小時，可以說是我們家最大的戲迷。
lines.simplified: 对啊，她不断地学新东西，现在还会在网路上看戏，一看就是好几个小时，可以说是我们家最大的戏迷。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, tā búduàn de xué xīn dōngxi, xiànzài hái huì zài wǎnglù shàng kàn xì, yí kàn jiù shì hǎo jǐ ge xiǎoshí, kěyǐ shuō shì wǒmen jiā zuì dà de xìmí.
lines.english: Yes, she keeps learning new things, and now she even watches dramas online, for hours at a time. You could say she is the biggest fan in our family.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 真不簡單！
lines.simplified: 真不简单！
lines.pinyin: Zhēn bù jiǎndān!
lines.english: That's impressive!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǎinai diànnǎo yòng de zuì hǎo.
choices.english: Grandma uses the computer best.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 家裡最愛看戲的是奶奶
choices.simplified: 家里最爱看戏的是奶奶
choices.pinyin: Jiā lǐ zuì ài kàn xì de shì nǎinai.
choices.english: Grandma is the one at home who loves dramas most.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiā lǐ měi ge rén dōu ài kàn xì.
choices.english: Everyone in the family loves dramas.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 奶奶每天學好幾個小時
choices.simplified: 奶奶每天学好几个小时
choices.pinyin: Nǎinai měi tiān xué hǎo jǐ ge xiǎoshí.
choices.english: Grandma studies for hours every day.

questions.why: 可以說是我們家最大的戲迷 sums up 一看就是好幾個小時: no one at home watches as much as she does. She is learning computers, not the best at them; the line does not say everyone else is a fan; the hours are spent watching dramas, not studying.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 今天的錄音怎麼到現在才結束？
lines.simplified: 今天的录音怎么到现在才结束？
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān de lùyīn zěnme dào xiànzài cái jiéshù?
lines.english: Why has today's recording only finished now?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 要不是那位演員一直把總統的名字念錯，兩點就錄完了。
lines.simplified: 要不是那位演员一直把总统的名字念错，两点就录完了。
lines.pinyin: Yàobúshì nà wèi yǎnyuán yìzhí bǎ zǒngtǒng de míngzi niàn cuò, liǎng diǎn jiù lù wán le.
lines.english: If that actor hadn't kept reading the president's name wrong, we'd have finished at two.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他念錯了幾次？
lines.simplified: 他念错了几次？
lines.pinyin: Tā niàn cuò le jǐ cì?
lines.english: How many times did he get it wrong?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 十幾次吧，最後導演只好請別人來念。
lines.simplified: 十几次吧，最后导演只好请别人来念。
lines.pinyin: Shí jǐ cì ba, zuìhòu dǎoyǎn zhǐhǎo qǐng biérén lái niàn.
lines.english: Ten-something times. In the end the director had to get someone else to read it.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 今天的錄音為什麼錄了那麼久？
prompt.simplified: 今天的录音为什么录了那么久？
prompt.pinyin: Jīntiān de lùyīn wèishénme lù le nàme jiǔ?
prompt.english: Why did today's recording take so long?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Liǎng diǎn cái kāishǐ lù.
choices.english: Recording only started at two.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yǒu rén yìzhí niàn bú duì.
choices.english: Someone kept reading it wrong.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn zhǎo bú dào biérén niàn.
choices.english: The director could not find anyone else to read.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng de míngzi gǎi le.
choices.english: The president's name changed.

questions.why: 要不是 + what really happened: the actor kept misreading the name, otherwise it would have ended at two. Two o'clock is when it would have ended, the director did find someone else, and the name never changed.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這個星期六晚上的戲，妳要不要一起去看？我有兩張票。
lines.simplified: 这个星期六晚上的戏，你要不要一起去看？我有两张票。
lines.pinyin: Zhège xīngqíliù wǎnshàng de xì, nǐ yào bú yào yìqǐ qù kàn? Wǒ yǒu liǎng zhāng piào.
lines.english: Do you want to come to the play this Saturday evening? I have two tickets.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好啊，我星期六沒事。不對，老闆說這個週末可能要加班。
lines.simplified: 好啊，我星期六没事。不对，老板说这个周末可能要加班。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a, wǒ xīngqíliù méi shì. Bú duì, lǎobǎn shuō zhège zhōumò kěnéng yào jiābān.
lines.english: Sure, I am free on Saturday. No, wait: my boss said we might have to work this weekend.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那怎麼辦？我的票是星期六晚上七點的。
lines.simplified: 那怎么办？我的票是星期六晚上七点的。
lines.pinyin: Nà zěnme bàn? Wǒ de piào shì xīngqíliù wǎnshàng qī diǎn de.
lines.english: So what now? My tickets are for seven on Saturday evening.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那得看老闆那天要不要我加班。我明天問問他，星期五以前告訴你。
lines.simplified: 那得看老板那天要不要我加班。我明天问问他，星期五以前告诉你。
lines.pinyin: Nà děi kàn lǎobǎn nà tiān yào bú yào wǒ jiābān. Wǒ míngtiān wènwen tā, xīngqíwǔ yǐqián gàosù nǐ.
lines.english: Then it depends on whether my boss needs me that day. I will ask him tomorrow and tell you by Friday.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的會去看戲嗎？
prompt.simplified: 女的会去看戏吗？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de huì qù kàn xì ma?
prompt.english: Will the woman go to the play?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíliù méi shì, tā huì qù.
choices.english: She is free on Saturday, so she will go.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bú qù, tā zhōumò děi jiābān.
choices.english: No, she has to work at the weekend.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíwǔ wǎnshàng cái néng qù.
choices.english: She can only go on Friday evening.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yào wèn guo lǎobǎn cái zhīdào.
choices.english: She will only know after asking her boss.

questions.why: 得看 + what decides it: she first says yes, then remembers the weekend overtime, so it depends on her boss. 星期六沒事 is her first answer, which she takes back; the overtime is only 可能; Friday is when she will tell him.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這個劇本有一百多頁，導演要我們明天早上以前就念完。
lines.simplified: 这个剧本有一百多页，导演要我们明天早上以前就念完。
lines.pinyin: Zhège jùběn yǒu yìbǎi duō yè, dǎoyǎn yào wǒmen míngtiān zǎoshàng yǐqián jiù niàn wán.
lines.english: This script is over a hundred pages, and the director wants us to have read it by tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 一個晚上念一百頁？誰念得了啊！我先念我演的那幾頁就好。
lines.simplified: 一个晚上念一百页？谁念得了啊！我先念我演的那几页就好。
lines.pinyin: Yí ge wǎnshàng niàn yìbǎi yè? Shéi niàn de liǎo a! Wǒ xiān niàn wǒ yǎn de nà jǐ yè jiù hǎo.
lines.english: A hundred pages in one evening? Who could manage that! I will just read the pages I am in first.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 也對，那其他的我們明天再一起看。
lines.simplified: 也对，那其他的我们明天再一起看。
lines.pinyin: Yě duì, nà qítā de wǒmen míngtiān zài yìqǐ kàn.
lines.english: Fair enough. Then let's look at the rest together tomorrow.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的打算怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 男的打算怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de dǎsuàn zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What does the man plan to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshàng quánbù niàn wán.
choices.english: Read all of it tonight.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qǐng dǎoyǎn duō gěi yì tiān.
choices.english: Ask the director for another day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiān kàn zìjǐ yǎn de dìfāng.
choices.english: First read the parts he plays.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Míngtiān cái kāishǐ niàn jùběn.
choices.english: Only start the script tomorrow.

questions.why: 誰念得了啊 means nobody can manage a hundred pages in one night, so he reads only his own pages first. Reading it all is what the director asked, he never asks for more time, and he does start tonight.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說你要離開石油公司了？那裡給的錢那麼多，你是不是一時沒想清楚就決定了？
lines.simplified: 听说你要离开石油公司了？那里给的钱那么多，你是不是一时没想清楚就决定了？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ yào líkāi shíyóu gōngsī le? Nàlǐ gěi de qián nàme duō, nǐ shì bú shì yìshí méi xiǎng qīngchǔ jiù juédìng le?
lines.english: I hear you're leaving the oil company? They pay so well. Did you just decide on a whim?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 錢是不少，可是我不快樂。我從小就想演戲，連做夢都夢到自己在演戲。上個月，有一位導演請我演他的新戲。
lines.simplified: 钱是不少，可是我不快乐。我从小就想演戏，连做梦都梦到自己在演戏。上个月，有一位导演请我演他的新戏。
lines.pinyin: Qián shì bù shǎo, kěshì wǒ bú kuàilè. Wǒ cóngxiǎo jiù xiǎng yǎnxì, lián zuòmèng dōu mèngdào zìjǐ zài yǎnxì. Shàng ge yuè, yǒu yí wèi dǎoyǎn qǐng wǒ yǎn tā de xīn xì.
lines.english: The money's good, but I'm not happy. I've wanted to act since I was a kid; I even dream I'm acting. Last month a director asked me to be in his new film.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 演戲很辛苦，錢也不多，你吃得了這個苦嗎？
lines.simplified: 演戏很辛苦，钱也不多，你吃得了这个苦吗？
lines.pinyin: Yǎnxì hěn xīnkǔ, qián yě bù duō, nǐ chī de liǎo zhège kǔ ma?
lines.english: Acting is hard work and doesn't pay much. Can you take that kind of hardship?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我已經存錢存了一年，這樣子就算半年沒工作也沒關係。再說，我已經三十歲了，現在不試，以後就沒機會了。
lines.simplified: 我已经存钱存了一年，这样子就算半年没工作也没关系。再说，我已经三十岁了，现在不试，以后就没机会了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng cún qián cún le yì nián, zhèyàngzi jiùsuàn bàn nián méi gōngzuò yě méi guānxi. Zàishuō, wǒ yǐjīng sānshí suì le, xiànzài bú shì, yǐhòu jiù méi jīhuì le.
lines.english: I've been saving for a year, so even half a year without work is fine. Besides, I'm already thirty; if I don't try now, I'll never get the chance.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼要離開石油公司？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么要离开石油公司？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme yào líkāi shíyóu gōngsī?
prompt.english: Why is the man leaving the oil company?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gōngsī gěi de qián tài shǎo le.
choices.english: The company pays too little.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yìshí méi xiǎng qīngchǔ.
choices.english: He did not think it through.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng qù zuò zìjǐ ài zuò de shì.
choices.english: He wants to do what he loves.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng duō cún yìdiǎn qián.
choices.english: He wants to save more money.

questions.why: He is not happy there and has wanted to act since childhood (從小就想演戲), and now a director has asked him. The pay is good (錢是不少), 一時沒想清楚 is only her worry, and he has already saved.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得為什麼現在就得試？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得为什么现在就得试？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde wèishénme xiànzài jiù děi shì?
prompt.english: Why does the man think he has to try now?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn zhǐ děng tā yì nián.
choices.english: The director will only wait a year for him.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Niánjì dà le jiù láibùjí le.
choices.english: When he is older it will be too late.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Cún de qián gòu yòng yì nián.
choices.english: His savings will last a year.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yǎnxì de qián bǐ yǐqián duō.
choices.english: Acting pays more than before.

questions.why: 再說 adds his second reason: he is thirty, and later there will be no chance. The savings are the first reason (they cover half a year without work; nothing says how long they last), and nothing is said about the director waiting.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽說導演要拍妳寫的劇本了？妳真厲害！
lines.simplified: 听说导演要拍你写的剧本了？你真厉害！
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō dǎoyǎn yào pāi nǐ xiě de jùběn le? Nǐ zhēn lìhài!
lines.english: I hear a director is going to film your script? That's amazing!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 別這麼說。故事講的是一位律師離婚以後，帶著女兒到鄉下生活。我還去鄉下住了一個月，這樣子才寫得出那裡的生活。
lines.simplified: 别这么说。故事讲的是一位律师离婚以后，带着女儿到乡下生活。我还去乡下住了一个月，这样子才写得出那里的生活。
lines.pinyin: Bié zhème shuō. Gùshì jiǎng de shì yí wèi lǜshī líhūn yǐhòu, dài zhe nǚ'ér dào xiāngxià shēnghuó. Wǒ hái qù xiāngxià zhù le yí ge yuè, zhèyàngzi cái xiě de chū nàlǐ de shēnghuó.
lines.english: Oh, it's nothing. The story is about a lawyer who moves to the countryside with his daughter after a divorce. I even lived in the countryside for a month; that was the only way I could write about life there.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那誰演那個律師？我弟弟怎麼樣？他當過模特兒，身高夠，長得也好看。
lines.simplified: 那谁演那个律师？我弟弟怎么样？他当过模特儿，身高够，长得也好看。
lines.pinyin: Nà shéi yǎn nàge lǜshī? Wǒ dìdi zěnmeyàng? Tā dāng guo mótèr, shēngāo gòu, zhǎng de yě hǎokàn.
lines.english: So who plays the lawyer? What about my brother? He used to model. He's tall enough and good-looking too.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 導演說那些都沒關係。他要找性格開朗的人，再說，年紀也得跟角色差不多。你弟弟太年輕了。
lines.simplified: 导演说那些都没关系。他要找性格开朗的人，再说，年纪也得跟角色差不多。你弟弟太年轻了。
lines.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn shuō nàxiē dōu méi guānxi. Tā yào zhǎo xìnggé kāilǎng de rén, zàishuō, niánjì yě děi gēn jiǎosè chàbùduō. Nǐ dìdi tài niánqīng le.
lines.english: The director says none of that matters. He wants someone with a cheerful personality, and besides, the age has to be close to the character's. Your brother is too young.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼去鄉下住了一個月？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么去乡下住了一个月？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme qù xiāngxià zhù le yí ge yuè?
prompt.english: Why did the woman live in the countryside for a month?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 想把鄉下生活寫得更像真的
choices.simplified: 想把乡下生活写得更像真的
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng bǎ xiāngxià shēnghuó xiě de gèng xiàng zhēn de.
choices.english: To make the country life in her story feel real.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gēn nǚ'ér yìqǐ qù shēnghuó.
choices.english: To live there with her daughter.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qù nàlǐ zhǎo yǎnyuán.
choices.english: To find actors there.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qù kàn dǎoyǎn zěnme pāi xì.
choices.english: To watch the director filming.

questions.why: 這樣子才寫得出那裡的生活: living there was how she could write country life well. The daughter belongs to the lawyer in her story, the director is the one looking for actors, and filming has not started.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 導演要找哪種人演律師？
prompt.simplified: 导演要找哪种人演律师？
prompt.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn yào zhǎo nǎ zhǒng rén yǎn lǜshī?
prompt.english: What kind of person does the director want to play the lawyer?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shēngāo gòu, zhǎng de hǎokàn.
choices.english: Tall enough and good-looking.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Niánqīng yòu yǒumíng de míngxīng.
choices.english: A young, famous star.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dāng guo mótèr de rén.
choices.english: Someone who has been a model.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gèxìng kāilǎng, niánjì gānghǎo.
choices.english: Cheerful, and just the right age.

questions.why: The director wants 性格開朗的人, and 再說 adds the second point: an age close to the character's. Height, looks and modelling are what the man offers, and the director says 那些都沒關係; young is the reason the brother is wrong.

Tā hěn kuài jiù shìyìng le Táiběi de shēnghuó, kěshì gāng kāishǐ zhǐ néng yǎn xiǎo jiǎosè, chángcháng yì tiān yào pāi shí jǐ ge xiǎoshí. Wǒ wèn tā pà bú pà chīkǔ, tā shuō: “Jiùsuàn yào děng hěn duō nián, wǒ yě yào yìzhí yǎn xiàqù.” Sān nián lái, tā búduàn liànxí, biǎoyǎn yuè lái yuè hǎo. Xiǎozhēn shuō, yàobúshì yǐqián nàxiē xīnkǔ de rìzi, tā jiù méiyǒu jīntiān de shílì.
passage.english: My roommate Xiaozhen has wanted to be an actress since she was little. After university she came to Taipei to pursue her dream. She soon adapted to life in Taipei, but at first she could only play small roles, often filming for ten-plus hours a day. I asked whether she minded the hardship, and she said, "Even if I have to wait many years, I will keep on acting." For three years she has kept practising, and her acting gets better and better. Last year a director saw her perform and asked her to play the daughter in his new film. As soon as the film came out, many people praised her performance. Xiaozhen says that if it weren't for those hard days, she wouldn't have the ability she has today.

Dìdi méiyǒu bù gāoxìng, háishì měi tiān yòng shǒujī pāi dōngxi, zài pèi shàng zìjǐ zhǎo de yīnyuè, fàng dào wǎnglù shàng. Tā yě xiàng bàmā bǎozhèng, yídìng xiān bǎ shū niàn hǎo. Bùguǎn gōngkè duō máng, tā dōu huì pāi yìdiǎn. Qùnián, tā pāi de yǐngpiàn zài bǐsài zhōng dé le dì yī míng, bàmā zhè cái dāying ràng tā qù xué diànyǐng.
passage.english: My younger brother has loved films since he was little, and his dream is to be a director. But we live in the countryside, where there are few resources to use; there is not even a cinema or a library nearby. Our parents were afraid he would have a hard life later; besides, the family had no money to send him to Taipei to study, so they hoped he would change his mind. My brother was not upset. He still filmed things on his phone every day, added music he had found, and put them online. He also promised our parents he would do his schoolwork first. No matter how busy he was with homework, he filmed a little. Last year a video of his won first prize in a competition, and only then did our parents agree to let him study film.

text.traditional:
在我父母那個年代，想當歌星或演員的年輕人，得先找到一家願意幫他的公司，才有機會讓大家看到自己的表演。現在不一樣了，只要有一支手機，就能拍出自己的影片，放到網路上給大家看。所以，很多人覺得現在追求夢想比以前容易多了。
我不太同意這樣的想法。資源多了，挑戰也跟著變大了。網路上每天都有幾萬部新影片，觀眾看了這麼多，要求也越來越高。一個人就算有了機會，如果沒有實力，很快就會被大家忘了。我有一位朋友很會唱歌，她把自己唱歌的影片放到網路上，前三年都沒什麼人看。她不斷改變自己唱歌的方式，每天練習六個小時，最近才開始有人肯定她。
所以我認為，光有一支手機還不夠，能不能夢想成真，要看你肯不肯吃苦。
text.simplified:
在我父母那个年代，想当歌星或演员的年轻人，得先找到一家愿意帮他的公司，才有机会让大家看到自己的表演。现在不一样了，只要有一支手机，就能拍出自己的影片，放到网路上给大家看。所以，很多人觉得现在追求梦想比以前容易多了。
我不太同意这样的想法。资源多了，挑战也跟着变大了。网路上每天都有几万部新影片，观众看了这么多，要求也越来越高。一个人就算有了机会，如果没有实力，很快就会被大家忘了。我有一位朋友很会唱歌，她把自己唱歌的影片放到网路上，前三年都没什么人看。她不断改变自己唱歌的方式，每天练习六个小时，最近才开始有人肯定她。
所以我认为，光有一支手机还不够，能不能梦想成真，要看你肯不肯吃苦。
text.pinyin: Zài wǒ fùmǔ nàge niándài, xiǎng dāng gēxīng huò yǎnyuán de niánqīngrén, děi xiān zhǎodào yì jiā yuànyì bāng tā de gōngsī, cái yǒu jīhuì ràng dàjiā kàndào zìjǐ de biǎoyǎn. Xiànzài bù yíyàng le, zhǐyào yǒu yì zhī shǒujī, jiù néng pāi chū zìjǐ de yǐngpiàn, fàng dào wǎnglù shàng gěi dàjiā kàn. Suǒyǐ, hěn duō rén juéde xiànzài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng bǐ yǐqián róngyì duō le. Wǒ bú tài tóngyì zhèyàng de xiǎngfǎ. Zīyuán duō le, tiǎozhàn yě gēn zhe biàn dà le. Wǎnglù shàng měi tiān dōu yǒu jǐ wàn bù xīn yǐngpiàn, guānzhòng kàn le zhème duō, yāoqiú yě yuè lái yuè gāo. Yí ge rén jiùsuàn yǒu le jīhuì, rúguǒ méiyǒu shílì, hěn kuài jiù huì bèi dàjiā wàng le. Wǒ yǒu yí wèi péngyǒu hěn huì chànggē, tā bǎ zìjǐ chànggē de yǐngpiàn fàng dào wǎnglù shàng, qián sān nián dōu méi shénme rén kàn. Tā búduàn gǎibiàn zìjǐ chànggē de fāngshì, měi tiān liànxí liù ge xiǎoshí, zuìjìn cái kāishǐ yǒu rén kěndìng tā. Suǒyǐ wǒ rènwéi, guāng yǒu yì zhī shǒujī hái bú gòu, néng bù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn, yào kàn nǐ kěn bù kěn chīkǔ.
text.english:
In my parents' day, a young person who wanted to be a singer or an actor first had to find a company willing to help, and only then had a chance to show people their work. It is different now: with just a phone you can make your own videos and put them online for everyone to see. So many people think chasing a dream is much easier now than before.
I do not quite agree. There are more resources, but the challenges have grown with them. Tens of thousands of new videos go online every day, and having seen so many, viewers expect more and more. Even if someone gets a chance, without real ability they are soon forgotten. A friend of mine sings very well. She puts videos of her singing online, and for the first three years hardly anyone watched. She kept changing the way she sings and practised six hours a day, and only recently have people begun to praise her.
So I think a phone alone is not enough: whether a dream comes true depends on whether you are willing to work hard.

text.english:
My younger sister has just come of age this year, and she is a big fan of a male star. She has watched every drama he has been in several times; to get his autograph she will queue outside all day, and she even dreams about him. At first our parents put up with it, but later they kept saying she had nothing in her head but that star and did not care about her own future at all.
I see it a little differently. Last year the star played a lawyer in a drama who helped many people without money. Because of that drama, my sister became interested in law. Now she has written herself a study plan, sets aside two hours a day to study, and hopes to get into a university law department next year. She says, "I know I can't see him every day, but I can become the kind of person he played."
In fact, how to like a star is a skill of its own. If it is only a passing interest, it soon fades; but if it makes you a better person, that kind of liking means a lot.

我從小就很害羞，很怕在很多人看著的時候說話。上大學以後，室友拉我參加了表演社團。第一次表演，我只演一個小角色，一共三句話。我在宿舍念了很多遍，覺得一定沒問題。誰知道表演一開始，看到下面坐滿了觀眾，我緊張得腦子裡什麼都想不起來，三句話一句也說不出來，差一點就哭了。還好旁邊的同學很快地幫我把那三句話說了，觀眾都沒看出來。
從那天起，我每天晚上都在宿舍裡練習，一遍一遍地念劇本，還請室友坐在對面當觀眾。現在，我已經能在禮堂演重要的角色了，心裡很滿足。我發現，只有不斷地練習，才能讓自己不怕在很多人看著的時候說話。

Dì yī cì biǎoyǎn, wǒ zhǐ yǎn yí ge xiǎo jiǎosè, yígòng sān jù huà. Wǒ zài sùshè niàn le hěn duō biàn, juéde yídìng méi wèntí. Shéi zhīdào biǎoyǎn yì kāishǐ, kàndào xiàmiàn zuò mǎn le guānzhòng, wǒ jǐnzhāng de nǎozi lǐ shénme dōu xiǎng bù qǐlái, sān jù huà yí jù yě shuō bù chūlái, chà yìdiǎn jiù kū le. Háihǎo pángbiān de tóngxué hěn kuài de bāng wǒ bǎ nà sān jù huà shuō le, guānzhòng dōu méi kàn chūlái. Cóng nà tiān qǐ, wǒ měi tiān wǎnshàng dōu zài sùshè lǐ liànxí, yí biàn yí biàn de niàn jùběn, hái qǐng shìyǒu zuò zài duìmiàn dāng guānzhòng. Xiànzài, wǒ yǐjīng néng zài lǐtáng yǎn zhòngyào de jiǎosè le, xīn lǐ hěn mǎnzú. Wǒ fāxiàn, zhǐyǒu búduàn de liànxí, cái néng ràng zìjǐ bú pà zài hěn duō rén kàn zhe de shíhòu shuōhuà.
text.english:
I have been shy since I was little and was afraid of speaking while lots of people watched. At university my roommate dragged me into the drama club. In my first show I only had a small role, with three lines in all. I read them over many times in the dorm and thought it would be fine. Who knew that as soon as the show began and I saw the seats full of people, I would be so nervous that I could not remember a thing? I could not say a single one of the three lines and almost cried. Luckily the classmate next to me quickly said those three lines for me, and the audience did not notice.
From that day on I practised in the dorm every evening, reading the script over and over, and asked my roommate to sit across from me as the audience. Now I can play important roles in the auditorium, and I feel content. I have found that only by practising again and again can I stop being afraid of speaking while lots of people watch.

我舅舅以前在一家石油公司當經理，每天都忙得很，常常加班到很晚。去年他退休了，大家都覺得他會在家好好休息。沒想到，第二個月他就開始學鋼琴了。
舅媽笑他：「你都六十五歲了，還學什麼鋼琴？不如去公園慢跑吧，對身體還比較有好處。」舅舅說：「對我來說，這是一個新的挑戰。我年輕的時候家裡窮，沒錢學，現在有時間了，我可不想再等了。」
他每天練習三個小時，進步得很快。上個月，他到附近的安養院表演給老人家聽，大家都拍手叫好。舅舅說，能追求年輕時候的夢想，還能讓別人開心，他已經很滿足了。現在，舅媽也不笑他了，還常常陪他一起去。
text.simplified:
我舅舅以前在一家石油公司当经理，每天都忙得很，常常加班到很晚。去年他退休了，大家都觉得他会在家好好休息。没想到，第二个月他就开始学钢琴了。
舅妈笑他：「你都六十五岁了，还学什么钢琴？不如去公园慢跑吧，对身体还比较有好处。」舅舅说：「对我来说，这是一个新的挑战。我年轻的时候家里穷，没钱学，现在有时间了，我可不想再等了。」
他每天练习三个小时，进步得很快。上个月，他到附近的安养院表演给老人家听，大家都拍手叫好。舅舅说，能追求年轻时候的梦想，还能让别人开心，他已经很满足了。现在，舅妈也不笑他了，还常常陪他一起去。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiùjiu yǐqián zài yì jiā shíyóu gōngsī dāng jīnglǐ, měi tiān dōu máng de hěn, chángcháng jiābān dào hěn wǎn. Qùnián tā tuìxiū le, dàjiā dōu juéde tā huì zài jiā hǎohǎo xiūxí. Méi xiǎngdào, dì èr ge yuè tā jiù kāishǐ xué gāngqín le. Jiùmā xiào tā: “Nǐ dōu liùshíwǔ suì le, hái xué shénme gāngqín? Bùrú qù gōngyuán mànpǎo ba, duì shēntǐ hái bǐjiào yǒu hǎochù.” Jiùjiu shuō: “Duì wǒ lái shuō, zhè shì yí ge xīn de tiǎozhàn. Wǒ niánqīng de shíhòu jiā lǐ qióng, méi qián xué, xiànzài yǒu shíjiān le, wǒ kě bù xiǎng zài děng le.” Tā měi tiān liànxí sān ge xiǎoshí, jìnbù de hěn kuài. Shàng ge yuè, tā dào fùjìn de ānyǎngyuàn biǎoyǎn gěi lǎorénjiā tīng, dàjiā dōu pāishǒu jiàohǎo. Jiùjiu shuō, néng zhuīqiú niánqīng shíhòu de mèngxiǎng, hái néng ràng biérén kāixīn, tā yǐjīng hěn mǎnzú le. Xiànzài, jiùmā yě bú xiào tā le, hái chángcháng péi tā yìqǐ qù.
text.english:
My uncle used to be a manager at an oil company. He was extremely busy and often worked overtime until late. Last year he retired, and everyone thought he would have a good rest at home. Instead, in his second month he started learning the piano.
My aunt laughed at him: "You're sixty-five. Why learn the piano now? You'd do better jogging in the park; it's better for your health." My uncle said, "For me this is a new challenge. When I was young my family was poor and had no money for lessons. Now I have the time, and I really don't want to wait any longer."
He practises three hours a day and is improving fast. Last month he played for the old people at a nearby care home, and everyone clapped and cheered. My uncle says that pursuing the dream of his youth and making others happy as well is enough to make him content. Now my aunt doesn't laugh at him any more; she often goes along with him.
